نستمدد (form X)
# نَسْتَمْدِدْ (nastamdid) /nas.tam.did/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْتَمَدَّ (istamadda)
# نُسْتَمْدَدْ (nustamdad) /nus.tam.dad/: first-person plural non-past passive jussive of اِسْتَمَدَّ (istamadda)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
